title: HB318 (2017 Regular): Public Safety - Firearms Disqualifications - Antique Firearm

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2017RS/bills/hb/hb0318f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed, January 25, 2017); no enrolled text was read. The bill deletes § 5-205(a), which said the subtitle does not apply to antique rifles or shotguns, and re-letters the rest. No passage vote is recorded.

Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-205(c)): A person who violates this section is guilty of a misdemeanor and on conviction is subject to imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or a fine not exceeding $1,000 or both.
